content.comment_body: Hello, apologies for joining a bit late. In [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], I am able to add [product_name] Operator Device ([product_name] TDE) within the network project. When configuring the TDE settings in the same software, there's a submenu called 'IP Host.' Is this essentially the same as choosing the [product_name] source from the TDE menu labeled '[product_name] selection'? To clarify, my objective is to have three different machines, each with a [product_name] module and [product_name] Operator Device, connected through Ethernet, allowing shared sensor status and alarms. Each operator device should function independently, displaying only its respective machine's state. Appreciate any guidance.

I don't have the [product_name] Operator Device [version_no], only a first-generation model without this configuration feature. However, I assume the IP address refers to the [product_name] Base Module being connected to the operator device.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working on networking multiple [product_name] Modules and [product_name] Operator Devices using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. There is uncertainty about how particular settings in the operator device configuration menus correspond, namely between 'IP Host' in the software and '[product_name] selection' on the hardware. This points to confusing or unclear menu terminology and highlights the need for dependable visualization and alarm sharing across networked devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect configuration options in the software to be straightforward and clearly mapped to hardware functions. They are seeking uncomplicated networking and seamless information exchange between [product_name] modules and operator devices, with independent visualization for each device.
